title: POST /groups ignores creator identity and hands out group keys
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_collection.py

spec/12-apps.md 18.8.2 Group Creation: POST coap://[creator-node]/groups. Creator automatically becomes owner. Encrypted create returns master_secret only on that creation response.

_create (191-238):
- encrypted=True only checks _pairwise_oscore_identity(request) is not None
- unencrypted=True/default has no OSCORE check
- record[\"owner\"] and record[\"members\"] are always self.owner
- the authenticated peer is not recorded and is not compared to self.owner
- encrypted 2.01 still includes master_secret

test_encrypted_create_pairwise_oscore_returns_master_secret sets oscore_context_id to \"edhoc-pairwise\" while owner is \"0200::1111\" and still expects CREATED plus master_secret. test_groups_create_and_list POSTs unencrypted groups with no OSCORE from a mesh client.

Consequence: any EDHOC peer can mint an encrypted group attributed to this node and receive the group OSCORE master_secret without being a member. Any mesh peer can mint unencrypted groups under the victim owner identity (DoS/cap tracked separately as worker6-bfzz). a594 closed the plaintext-key case; this is the remaining creator-authorization hole.
acceptance_criteria: Encrypted POST /groups 2.01 only when the pairwise OSCORE identity is the collection owner (or a documented LCI principal). That identity becomes owner and is the only member at create. Any other pairwise peer gets 4.03 and no master_secret. Unencrypted POST is not mesh-open: same owner bind or 4.01. Tests: non-owner pairwise encrypted create has no key material and does not insert a group; owner pairwise still creates.
close_reason: POST /groups now requires one unambiguous live pairwise OSCORE identity matching the configured owner for encrypted and unencrypted creation. The authenticated creator is the sole initial member; non-owner, absent, spoofed, group, and conflicting contexts fail before mutation or key disclosure. Creation is serialized and entropy failures return 5.00 without state, permitting retry. Full group/OSCORE tests, Ruff, and focused mypy passed.
